title: Sessions and login roles
description: For each session return its session_id and role_name. Return exactly two columns: session_id, role_name. Sort by session_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT s.id AS session_id, r.role_name
FROM sessions AS s
hints: INNER JOIN is sufficient because every test session has a role.
solution_explanation: This task reinforces joining a fact row to the roles lookup table.
